name: Default
shortDescription: Programmable double-entry financial ledger with a REST API, Numscript transactions and PostgreSQL storage, behind a token-protected gateway.

alerts.message: There is no web UI. The ledger API has no authentication of its own, so every request goes through a gateway that requires the generated LEDGER_API_TOKEN from the environment settings as an Authorization: Bearer <token> header. Example: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://<your-domain>/v2/main creates a ledger named main.
